from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # Divider is the full line whose color occurs nowhere outside that line.
    vcuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and counts[grid[0][c]] == h]
    hcuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and counts[grid[r][0]] == w]
    if vcuts:
        c = vcuts[0]
        a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        a = [row[-n:] for row in a]
        b = [row[:n] for row in b]
    else:
        r = hcuts[0]
        a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[-n:], b[:n]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg = min(common) if common else 4
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else bg for j in range(len(a[0]))]
            for i in range(len(a))]
